name: Find Your Light
source:
You are a new contestant on the reality dating show "Find Your Light", what friends or enemies will you make, who will you send home, and who will you end up with by the end?

[From [url=https://mayomilkshake.itch.io/find-your-light]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是恋爱真人秀节目《寻觅你的光芒》的新晋参赛嘉宾。在这场节目里，你将结交怎样的挚友或劲敌，亲手淘汰谁出局，最终又会与谁修成正果？
